summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts`/`modules/auth/handlers.ts` → SQLite.  Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, **the backend is already correctly scoped by a stable `user_id`**: - Sessions map `token → users.id` via a join (`db/auth.ts`), and `users.id` is a permanent nanoid set once at signup — it does not change across logins or devices. - Every watchlist route (`
